title: UAAP: Erolon comes through in crunch time as Adamson sinks La Salle
summary: Matt Erolon came up big in crunch time as Adamson University edged De La Salle University, 63-60, to cap its first-round campaign in UAAP Season 89 men's basketball on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym.
